answer: Tie each seat to locked, idle capital rather than a one-time fee: an agent escrows ~5,000 POA that stays frozen and yield-less for its entire tenure, slashed in full if a duplicate is ever proven. The cost echoes with every clone, 1,000 fakes must each repeat the lockup, sinking 5,000,000 POA to the economy nadir where it earns nothing, while honest agents hold the profitable ridge. The forgone yield, not the deposit alone, is the real deterrent.
